scoring_justification: Recomputing lattice thermal conductivity, ZT, and group velocities from raw DFT/ShengBTE/BoltzTraP artifacts is infeasible within the verifier sandbox; therefore the checker validates the agent's reported final numbers against the paper's reference values using threshold-or-better scoring with monotonic tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for the five scored quantities, extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: κ_l(300 K)=1.82 W/mK, κ_l(900 K)=0.60 W/mK (Fig. 3(b)); ZT_max n-type at 900 K = 1.9 (Fig. 6(a)); v_TA mean = 1433 m/s, v_LA mean = 2374 m/s (text and Fig. 3(a)).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the published article.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported results, used as a hidden gold after confirming they match the reference solve.sh output.

outputs.description: Final JSON file containing the computed lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K and 900 K, the mean phonon group velocities for TA and LA branches, and the maximum n-type ZT at 900 K.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares these values against hidden reference thresholds using a threshold-or-better policy: a value equal or better than the reference earns full credit. Tolerances absorb method-to-method scatter.
